# Tier 2 (Claude Code hook) bench fixtures — one command per line.
#
# Each command is fed through `contextcrawler hook claude` wrapped in a
# synthetic Claude Code PreToolUse envelope. The harness records what the
# hook rewrote it to, then runs BOTH the raw command and the rewritten
# command in a sandbox and compares output token counts to compute the
# real end-to-end savings the user would have seen.
#
# Lines beginning with `#` are skipped. Blank lines are skipped. Commands
# are expected to be read-only and safe to run inside the repo working
# tree — no mutating git ops, no network, no installs.
#
# Selection criteria: representative load (read-heavy, list-heavy,
# structured-output) and bounded runtime (each under ~5s on a dev box).

git status
git log -5 --oneline
git diff HEAD~1 --stat
head -50 src/main.rs
ls -la src/
grep -rn secure_command src/core/utils.rs
find . -maxdepth 3 -name *.rs -path ./src/*
htop
